surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 50 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Mursalaat (The Emissaries) is the 77th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 50 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والمرسلات عرفا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the winds that blow violently
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: violently storming

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: scattering far and wide

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those [angels] who bring criterion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: separating forcefully

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And those [angels] who deliver a message
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: delivering a reminder

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As justification or warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a proof or a warning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: what you are promised will come to pass

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So when the stars are obliterated
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the stars are dimmed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the heaven is opened
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the sky is torn apart

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the mountains are blown away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the mountains are turned to dust

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the messengers' time has come
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the messengers given their appointed time––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For what Day was it postponed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for what Day has all this been set

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For the Day of Judgement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Day of Decision

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did We not destroy the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not destroy the first [of them]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We will follow them with the later ones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall make the last follow them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thus do We deal with the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this is how We deal with the guilty

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We placed it in a firm lodging
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: which We housed in a safe lodging

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For a known extent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for a determined period

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have We not made the earth a container
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not make the earth a home

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Of the living and the dead
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: for the living and the dead

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتࣲ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءࣰ فُرَاتࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجعلنا فيها رواسي شامخات واسقيناكم ماء فراتا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انطلقوا الى ما كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلࣲّ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انطلقوا الى ظل ذي ثلاث شعب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّا ظَلِيلࣲ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks

ayahs.translation_saheeh: As if they were yellowish [black] camels
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and as bright as copper

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is a Day they will not speak
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day they will be speechless

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And fruits from whatever they desire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and any fruit they desire

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما كنتم تعملون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this is how We reward those who do good.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذا قيل لهم اركعوا لا يركعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In what revelation, after this, will they believe
